messages:
alex: FYI found a console/telemetry gap: when an org-scoped API key is exchanged into a project context the trace view only shows the project as the effective identity. That makes it hard to map back to the originating org for billing/owner lookup.
maria: Can you paste repro steps and a minimal trace dump? I want to confirm whether the origin is being dropped at proxy or during indexing.
alex: Repro: 1) create org key 2) call /v1/exchange -> receives project-scoped token 3) call /v1/generate with header `X-Redwood-Proxied-Project: proj-abc`. In request detail UI the trace detail shows `effective_project=proj-abc` and no origin. Header dump below.
```
Authorization: Bearer orgkey-acme-xxx
X-Redwood-Proxied-Project: proj-abc
X-Redwood-Origin: org:acme
X-Request-ID: req-0a1b2c
```
sahil: We actually capture `X-Redwood-Origin` at ingress in raw logs. The issue is the console indexer canonicalizes identity into a single low-cardinality `effective_identity` column; it overwrites origin when project is present. Could add `origin_org` as a separate indexed tag.
kevin: Adding another index/tag increases ES/Kinesis write budget and cardinality. Also important: org names are sensitive; exposing them in project-scoped dashboards might violate least-privilege. Need RBAC gating.
maria: UX proposal: keep `effective_identity` as-is (backwards compatible) but show a small "origin" badge in the request detail pane when present. The badge would be hidden unless the viewer has `read_org` scope. Also add a filter option `origin:org-name` that respects RBAC.
alex: Rollout plan suggestion: feature flag `console.show_origin_in_traces` default off. Enable in staging for 2 weeks, gather metrics: percent of traces with origin, filter usage, and RBAC errors. If safe, enable to internal users then opt-in external orgs.
sahil: Implementation notes: 1) ingress proxy: preserve `X-Redwood-Origin` into request envelope metadata. 2) telemetry pipeline: emit `origin_org` as a low-cardinality field (string), index with separate mapping. 3) console: add badge UI + filter dropdown. 4) backend: don't change `effective_identity` semantics. Also add a compact kinesis event: `event_type=origin_hint, origin=acme, request_id=req-0a1b2c` for quick rollups.
kevin: We'll need a cost estimate for the additional index. Also a migration for historical traces (reindexing is expensive). Maybe only index forward-looking events and keep a searchable raw log fallback for older traces.
lucy: From product: agree on conservative rollout. Need wording for customer-facing changelog explaining that we now surface "origin" for org-scoped keys in traces if you have permission; emphasise privacy controls and opt-in. Also let's add a knob for org-admins to disable origin propagation if they want.
kevin: Good call on org-admin toggle — avoids leaking cross-org info inside large customers. That can be enforced at token-exchange time (strip `X-Redwood-Origin` if org opts out).
sahil: Dev work split: ingress + envelope changes (infra), telemetry pipeline index mapping (eng-ml / infra), console UI + RBAC checks (eng-platform), permission gating (auth). I'll open PRs and link them.
alex: Example minimal kinesis event (for devs):
```json
{"event_type":"origin_hint","request_id":"req-0a1b2c","origin_org":"acme","effective_project":"proj-abc","ts":6451240000}
```
kevin: Ensure that event is scrubbed for PII in case org names are sensitive — maybe hash the org id in analytics while leaving readable name in console for permitted users.
maria: Okay I'll prototype UI badge tomorrow. Can I get someone to own the telemetry index mapping? @sahil?
sahil: I'll take telemetry mapping + kinesis event. Will share sample mapping and cardinality numbers by EOD.
deploy-bot: flag `console.show_origin_in_traces` set ON in staging for team:eng-platform by lucy at 2026-03-22T10:12:03Z :sparkles:
alex: TY! We'll watch metrics next two weeks. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all — next steps: sahil opens mapping PR, infra makes envelope change, kevin and auth design org opt-out, lucy drafts changelog.
kevin: Heads-up: don't forget to add unit/integration tests for RBAC gating so we don't accidentally leak origin to project viewers.
alex: noted. Closing thread, will follow up with links to PRs. :wave:
